Kerala Class 11 admissions conclude amid seat shortage concerns

Kerala has concluded the main phase of Class 11 admissions with the release of the third allotment list. While a significant number of students have secured seats, a shortage of merit seats remains, prompting the government to consider temporary batches. Separately, a political row has erupted over the appointment of the State Election Commissioner.
